products.title: The Five Minute Journal — original linen
products.desc: Five minutes a day, on paper. Gratitude in the morning, a win at night — the linen original, no app required.

details.label: Care
details.value: Wipe the cover; do not machine wash a book

reviews.name: Maya O.
reviews.body: Two weeks in and it is the only habit that stuck. The prompts are short enough that I actually do them.

reviews.name: Devon P.
reviews.body: Paper is lovely. Wish the elastic were tighter — mine has already loosened.

reviews.name: Alex C.
reviews.body: Bought it for the gratitude thing, kept it for the evening win. Good buy.

products.title: Southern Gothic — peach bourbon black tea
products.desc: Black tea with peach and a whisper of bourbon smoke. Tastes like a porch at dusk.

reviews.name: Priya R.
reviews.body: Tastes exactly like the description, which almost never happens. The smoke is faint, not perfume.

reviews.name: Sam W.
reviews.body: Great cold-brewed overnight. A bit delicate hot if you steep past four minutes.

products.title: Nautilus towels
products.desc: Heavyweight Turkish cotton, woven in Denizli. The good-hotel towel, dorm edition.

details.label: Size
details.value: Hand 20 × 30 in · Bath 30 × 58 in · Set is one of each

details.label: Care
details.value: Machine wash warm, tumble low, no softener

reviews.name: Nina A.
reviews.body: Hotel-heavy. Took two washes to get fully absorbent, then perfect.

reviews.name: Jonah R.
reviews.body: Bath size is genuinely large. Takes a while to dry in a dorm bathroom.

products.title: Shadmoor towels
products.desc: Same Turkish cotton, moodier stripe. Your shower caddy just got promoted.

details.label: Size
details.value: Hand 20 × 30 in · Bath 30 × 58 in · Set is one of each

details.label: Care
details.value: Machine wash warm, tumble low, no softener

reviews.name: Alex C.
reviews.body: The stripe is subtler in person, which I prefer. Same weight as the Nautilus.

products.title: Umbra towels
products.desc: Waffle-weave, quick-dry, half the hook space. Built for shared bathrooms.

details.label: Size
details.value: Hand 20 × 30 in · Bath 30 × 58 in · Set is one of each

details.label: Care
details.value: Machine wash warm, tumble low, dries in half the time

reviews.name: Maya O.
reviews.body: The point is the drying time and it delivers. Half a day on a hook, not two.

reviews.name: Sam W.
reviews.body: Thinner than I expected. Fine for the gym, less luxurious than the others.

products.title: BiBi star print stripe combo top
products.desc: Star-print stripe combo that reads vintage. The going-out top for the pre-game fit check.

details.label: Size
details.value: Model is 5’9” wearing S. Runs true to size

reviews.name: Priya R.
reviews.body: Fits like the photo. The stripe combo reads vintage without trying too hard.

reviews.name: Nina A.
reviews.body: Runs true. Sleeves are a little short on me but I am long-armed.

products.title: Solra sparkling yuzu — 12-pack
products.desc: Yuzu, a little salt, no sugar. The 12-pack the unboxing mission films — cold in twenty minutes, gone in a week.

details.label: Contains
details.value: Sparkling water, yuzu juice, sea salt

details.label: Keep
details.value: Cool and out of the sun; best within 9 months

reviews.name: Nina A.
reviews.body: Tastes like the top of a lemon without the sugar crash. My dorm fridge is now a Solra fridge.

reviews.name: Jonah R.
reviews.body: Good, but twelve goes fast when your roommate finds it.

products.title: Loop demo night kit
products.desc: Everything a dorm demo night needs in one box: the Loop, a speaker cable, twenty guest cards and the host's cheat sheet.

reviews.name: Priya R.
reviews.body: Ran a night for eleven people off this box alone. The cheat sheet is the best part.

products.title: Dermabell glass skin serum
products.desc: The serum behind the salon mission: niacinamide and snail mucin, morning and night, two drops. Fragrance-free.

details.label: Use
details.value: Two drops on clean skin, then moisturiser

reviews.name: Sam W.
reviews.body: Three weeks and my skin stopped being angry at me. Sinks in fast, no smell.

reviews.name: Devon P.
reviews.body: Works, pricey for a student. The cashback helps.
